utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s picking up nicely. I still don’t have the exact time or spot yet, but I’m hearing they may need tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m late as usual. What time and place are we still waiting on?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Still waiting on the exact time and location — I only know it’s coming up soon. If I hear more, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check my schedule and see if I can take a shift around 4:30. I can also spread the word to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d help a lot, Mara. If you can, please mention the community hall and the corner store bulletin board too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll mention the community hall and the corner store bulletin board when I spread the word. I’ll check my schedule for a 4:30 shift too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my tool kit and a few basic supplies for the drive. Just let me know what Eli still needs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—that’d really help. I’m still waiting on Leo to lock in the time, but I’ll let you know what Eli needs as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just keep me posted, and I’ll bring whatever fits the list once Eli has it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — please send the list and I’ll do my best to follow it. I think the loose fence board is still on my side, and Rey’s got the cracked porch step today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the remaining list and keep everyone posted. Right now it’s the loose fence board on your side, the cracked porch step with Rey, and Cleo is watching supplies for anything we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on the loose fence board and wait for the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and set aside anything the group can spare for the repair drive. Vik’s spreading the word, and Rosa’s keeping the requests organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, that sounds organized. Just to confirm, Sam wants me to bring a notepad and whatever tools I already have, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that sounds right—please bring a notepad and any tools you already have. Rosa can add the rest to the list if anything’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away and invite a few more neighbors today. I’ll let Uli know who can help once I’ve heard back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll check what’s still needed while I’m out running errands and pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep reaching out today and send Uli an update as soon as I hear back from folks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still checking a couple details before I confirm the time. If Rosa needs anything from me, let me know what tools or parts to bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the timing and what to bring, so I’ll let you know as soon as I know. Tess is asking around about the schedule and supplies list too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia. I’ll wait for the list from Rosa and confirm the time once I’ve checked the last details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s picking up nicely, and I’m glad we’ve got a good turnout so far. I’m going to start by reaching out to folks on Maple Street and post the notice at the corner store bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Jules. Let’s still confirm the time, location, and whether we need any extra tools or parts before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll gather those details and confirm the time, location, and any extra tools or parts before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send Leo the list of tools and parts we still need. Cleo’s checking supplies too, so we should be in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, that should help a lot. I’m going to check the cracked step by the porch today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey—that would be a big help. Please let me know what you find, and I’ll keep the repair list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve asked around, and I’m still trying to pin down the timing for the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what supplies they want us to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. Quinn’s going to spread the word and check with a few more neighbors today, so we should know who can help soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that should help a lot — I’ll keep asking about the timing and the supplies list, and I’ll pass along anything I hear right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira said they’d check what’s still on the list—do we still need tools, spare parts, or volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus is handling the basics and the tools, so I’m just keeping a neat list of what’s left. We’ll still need to check on spare parts and whether we have enough volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—please check on the spare parts and volunteer count, then let me know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll spread the word to the other parents and bring a few supplies. Just send me the repair drive details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — I’m starting by checking what needs fixing first, then I’ll gather the useful supplies from the back shed and porch boxes and bring them to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep me posted on what you find, and I’ll spread the word and bring a few supplies over to the hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word today and invite a few more neighbors right away. I’ll let Uli know who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—Sam’s still leading the first check of what needs fixing, right? I’ll bring a notepad and the tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, Sam’s still leading the first check. Thanks, Kira — your notepad and tools will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check what’s still needed for the repair drive while I’m out running errands, and I’ll let you know if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep sharing the plan and pass along the remaining task list to everyone. Oren’s ready to help, and Cleo’s watching supplies, so we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep an ear out and check what’s still needed while I’m out. I’ll pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m making a neat little list of what we still need, and Gus is bringing the tools and the basics over. That should keep the repair drive moving along nicely.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, then I’ll check the cracked step by the porch today. If I hear anything about the loose fence board, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds perfect, Rey. I’ll keep my list updated and let you know if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We still need to confirm the time, the location, and whether any tools or parts are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 after pickup still works for me, and I can help spread the word to other parents. I’ll also check on a few volunteers and see if we still need any tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — 4:30 after pickup works, and I appreciate you checking on volunteers and any missing tools or parts. Let me know what you find so we can lock in the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s picking up nicely. I still need the exact time and place, but I’ll keep an ear out for what tools, parts, or volunteers they need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m on it — I’ll pass it along to the other parents and bring a few supplies too. Once Faye sends the time and place, I’ll share that as well.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep watching for Faye’s update on the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s really picking up nicely so far, and I’m going to start by reaching out to the folks on Maple Street. I’ll also post the notice at the corner store bulletin board to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — what still needs confirming for the repair drive? I’m happy to help lock down the time, location, or any tools and parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — I’m still gathering the last details, especially the final time, location, and any tools or parts we should have on hand. If you can help confirm those, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll wait for Leo to confirm the time. And thanks, Gus, I may take you up on those tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the timing and what to bring — I don’t want to show up missing something.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, fair — just let me know once Leo locks the time, and I can bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sam’s checking the back shed and porch boxes for supplies, and Jules is spreading the word on Maple Street and at the corner store board.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — Rosa’s still putting the details together, and I’m just checking one or two things before I confirm the time. Once she sends the list, I’ll see what tools or parts you still need from me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — once Rosa sends the list, I can match it against what Sam brings from the shed and porch boxes. Then we’ll know what still needs to come from you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — could you ask a few more neighbors to help today and let me know who can pitch in? That would really help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can ask around and see who’s free to pitch in today. I’ll also check the back shed and porch boxes for any useful repair supplies and bring them to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — that would help a lot. Please let me know who can come by today, and I really appreciate you checking for supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still asking around about the repair drive timing and what supplies to bring. As soon as I hear anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess. If you hear back, can you tell me what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know what’s still needed as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, we’ve still got that loose fence board on the list, and Rey’s already taking a look at the cracked step by the porch today. If you’ve got the repair-drive list handy, send it my way and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list and I’ll keep an eye on the supplies side too. If we can spare anything for the fence board or porch step, I’ll set it aside.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. If you can set aside anything useful for the fence board, I’ll keep track of the rest and follow the list as best I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring some extra tools and basic supplies for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Gus — thank you. I’m aiming for the repair drive around 4:30 after pickup, and I’ll check my schedule to see if I can take a shift too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and supplies, and I’ll check in with Eli’s list too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
